0000: A = arch
0001: if (A != ARCH_X86_64) goto 0011
0002: A = sys_number
0003: if (A < 0x40000000) goto 0011
0004: if (A == x32_read) goto 0011
0005: if (A == x32_write) goto 0011
0006: if (A == x32_iopl) goto 0011
0007: if (A != x32_mmap) goto 0011
0008: A = args[0]
0009: if (A == 0x0) goto 0011
0010: return ERRNO(5)
0011: return ALLOW
